— “the question for opinion is: Are persons who essociate 
with criminals guilty of committing a crime against the

Mr. burdett'*s translation of Article 161 of the 
Criminal Code provides: : 
be "Whoever associates with any society or gang 
formed with the object of committing crime shall 
be punished with imprisomment for not more than 
three years or detention, or a fine of not more

imprisonment for not less than one year, and not 
more than seven years."

Article 161 of the Criminal, Code was never intended to

crime. Before a conviction can be obtained under 
Article 161, it is necessary to prove, (1) the exis-

committing crime; and (2) that the accused has actually 
joined and/or is a member of such society cr gang. 
According to the explanation given after this article 
in the official Chinese publication of the Code, it 

was originally intended to strike at secret societies 
which are formed for the purpose of committing crime. 
Some of these societies might be what are known as the 
Tsing Pong ch # ) or the Hong Pong ( 22 % ). The now 
defunct Anti-Japanese National Salvation Society might 
also come within the meaning of Article 161. 

* During my almost four years tenure as Municipal 
Advocate, 1 cannot recall having seen a judgment of the 
Chinese Courta in the Settlement which convicted a per- 
son of being a member of a society formed for the object 
of committing crime contrary to Article 161. The fact 
that @man is arrested in company with persons who are 
later convicted of crime is, of course, exceedingly 
suspicious, but I believe you will agree that it is 
not sufficient evidence to convict. In order to obtain 
a convict ior, gome concrete evidence of some other 
crime, or of aiding and abetting must be produced. 

In this connection, I would call your attention to. 
Article 162 of the Criminal Code which makes it an of-

to convict under this article, however, there must be 
proof that the accused had knowledge of the intention 
to commit the crime before it was committed.

Memo. No. 420.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C & S. B. REGISTRY
Headquarters, D 3519.
27. 4. 32.
Shanghai Municipal Police,
April 26, 1932.

Criminal Gangs.

The attached opinion of the Municipal Advocate
is circulated for general information. In connection
therewith I shall be glad if you will give instructions
which will effectually dispel the idea that Article 161
can be used indiscriminately to obtain time to investigate
a case. In this respect it is necessary to point out
that it is the duty of all police officers to see that
sufficient evidence is available to prove (prima facie)
any charge preferred against an accused person. Article
161 is no exception to this rule and as in the opinion
of the M.A. it is practically impossible to convict under
this article it would appear improper to use it to obtain
detention for enquiries and so unnecessarily keep persons
in custody until the conclusion of a case.

R. A. Myers
Deputy Commissioner
(Crime Branch)

犯罪团伙。

现随函附上市政法务官的意见书，供各方知悉。就此事宜，如蒙阁下下达指令，以有效消除“可随意援引第161条以获取调查案件时间”这一观念，本人将不胜感激。在此方面，有必要指出，所有警务人员均有责任确保拥有充分证据，以初步证明（prima facie）对被告提出的任何指控。第161条亦不例外；鉴于市政法务官认为，依据该条款实际上几乎不可能定罪，因此，利用该条款获取拘留时间以便进行调查，从而不必要地将人员羁押至案件终结，似乎是不妥当的。

R. A. Myers
副总监
（刑事科）

pages.en:
In re ASSOCIATION OF CRIMINALS.

The question for opinion is: Are persons who associate
with criminals guilty of committing crimes against the
laws of China?

Mr. Burdett's translation of Article 161 of the
Criminal Code provides:

"Whoever associates with any society or gang
formed with the object of committing crime shall
be punished with imprisonment for not more than
three years or detention, or fine of not more
than 500 yuan, ringleaders shall be punished with
imprisonment for not less than one year, and not
more than seven years."

Mr. Burdett translates the two characters Tsai Yui (參與)
"associates". In an excellent Chinese-English Dictionary
edited by Mr. C. Z. Tsang, the meaning of the character
"Tsai" is, "to take part in, to participate, to be concerned
with". The character "Yui" is a conjunction and means
"with". The two characters combined, according to the
above named dictionary mean "to take part in, to
participate; to share; to join in".

Mr. Kun, Mr. Ru and myself do not agree with Mr.
Burdett's translation. According to our opinion, the
correct translation of Article 161 should read as follows:

"Whoever joins or is a member of any
society or gang . . ."

Article 161 of the Criminal Code was never intended to
make persons who associate with criminals guilty of
crime. Before a conviction can be obtained under
Article 161, it is necessary to prove, (1) the existence
of a society or gang formed for the purpose of committing
crime, and (2) that the accused has actually joined
and/or is a member of such society or gang. According
to the explanation given after this article in the official
Chinese publication of the Code, it was originally intended
to strike at secret societies which are formed for the
purpose of committing crime. Some of these societies
might be what are known as the Tsing Pong (青幫) or
**〔此处转录不清〕**
pages.zh:
关于与罪犯结伙之事。

需征询意见的问题是：与罪犯结伙之人，是否犯有违反中国法律之罪行？

伯德特（Burdett）先生对《刑法典》第161条的译文如下：

“凡参与以犯罪为目的而组成之社团或帮派者，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或五百元以下罚金；首要分子处一年以上七年以下有期徒刑。”

伯德特先生将“参与”二字译为“associates”（结伙/交往）。在曾宗泽（C. Z. Tsang）先生编纂的一部优秀的汉英词典中，“参”字的意思是“参加、参与、涉及”。“与”字是连词，意为“和”。根据上述词典，这两个字合起来的意思是“参加、参与；分享；加入”。

昆先生（Mr. Kun）、鲁先生（Mr. Ru）和本人都不同意伯德特先生的翻译。我们认为，第161条的正确译文应为：

“凡加入或成为任何社团或帮派成员者……”

《刑法典》第161条的本意绝非使仅与罪犯交往之人获罪。要依据第161条获得定罪，必须证明：(1) 存在一个以犯罪为目的而组成的社团或帮派；以及 (2) 被告确实已加入和/或是该社团或帮派的成员。根据该法典中文官方出版物中在该条之后的解释，该条原意旨在打击以犯罪为目的而组成的秘密会社。其中一些会社可能就是所谓的青帮（Tsing Pong）或
**〔此处转录不清〕**

2.
the Hong Pong (紅幫). The now defunct anti-Japanese
National Salvation Society might also come within the
meaning of Article 161.
During my almost four years tenure as Municipal
Advocate, I cannot recall having seen a judgment of the
Chinese Courts in the Settlement which convicted a
person of being a member of a society formed for the object
of committing crime contrary to Article 161. The fact
that a man is arrested in company with persons who are
later convicted of crime is, of course, exceedingly
suspicious, but I believe you will agree that it is
not sufficient evidence to convict. In order to obtain
a conviction, some concrete evidence of some other
crime, or of aiding and abetting must be produced.
In this connection, I would call your attention to
Article 162 of the Criminal Code which makes it an
offence for persons to fail to report the crimes specified
in the article before they are committed. In order
to convict under this article, however, there must be
proof that the accused had knowledge of the intention
to commit the crime before it was committed.
Under the common law, vagrancy is an offence. Under
this law, all idle or dissolute persons who have no
visible means of support or lawful occupation or employment
by which to earn a living are subject to punishment.
Article 43, Section 1 of the Police Regulations makes
it an offence to roam about without any business
and to act in a questionable manner, subject to detention
not exceeding fifteen days, or fine not exceeding
fifteen dollars. I seriously doubt if a conviction could
be obtained against a person who associates with criminals
under Article 47, Section 1 of the Police Regulations
unless it could be proved that he was without business
and roaming about in a suspicious manner. As have
examined
pages.zh:
2.
红帮（Hong Pong）。现已解散的反日救国会也可能属于第161条的含义范围。
在我担任市政法务官的近四年任期内，我不记得曾见过租界内中国法院作出过依据第161条判定某人作为以犯罪为目的而组成的社团成员有罪的判决。当然，某人与后来被判定犯有罪行的人一同被捕，这一事实极其可疑，但我相信阁下会同意，这不足以作为定罪的证据。为了获得定罪，必须提供关于其他某些犯罪或关于从犯及教唆犯的具体证据。
在此方面，提请阁下注意《刑法典》第162条，该条规定，对于该条所列之犯罪，未在犯罪发生前举报者，构成犯罪。然而，要依据该条定罪，必须有证据证明被告在犯罪发生前知晓犯罪意图。
根据普通法，流浪罪属于犯罪。根据该法律，所有无可见生活来源、无合法职业或工作以谋生的闲散或放荡之人，均应受到惩罚。《警务规章》第43条第1款规定，无事游荡且行为可疑者属违法，可处不超过十五日的拘留或不超过十五元的罚款。我严重怀疑，除非能证明某人无事可做且以可疑方式游荡，否则能否依据《警务规章》第47条第1款（原文如此，疑为笔误，上下文指第43条）对与罪犯交往的人定罪。正如已经审查

pages.en:
3.
examined the law carefully but can find nothing which
exactly covers the point.
It has been the custom of the police for some years,
when making arrests of a large number of alleged criminals,
to charge them under Article 161 and ask for a remand
in order to obtain time to investigate the case.
Subsequently evidence is often obtained against some of
the men arrested, but not all, of their crimes. The
convictions, if any, are generally for crimes other than
those specified in Article 161 or 162. I have indicated
verbally to police officers from time to time that this
practice should be discontinued. When arrests are made
and the case is not ready for trial, the accused should
not be charged under Article 161, unless there is
evidence of the offence provided for in said article, but
should be placed on a writ of detention. After the
conclusion of the investigations, charges can be preferred
in accordance with the specific crimes which the
police feel they have sufficient evidence to prove. If
there is not sufficient evidence an application should
be made for their release.

(Signed) R. T. Bryan, Jr.
Municipal Advocate.

仔细审查了法律，但找不到完全涵盖此点的规定。
多年来，警方在逮捕大量涉嫌罪犯时，习惯依据第161条对其提出指控，并申请还押，以便获得调查案件的时间。随后，往往能获取针对部分被捕男子其他罪行的证据，但并非针对所有人。若有定罪，通常也是针对第161条或第162条规定以外的罪行。我曾不时口头向警务人员表示，这种做法应当停止。当实施逮捕且案件尚未准备好审理时，除非有证据证明存在该条规定的罪行，否则不应依据第161条对被告提出指控，而应将其置于拘留令之下。调查结束后，可根据警方认为有充分证据证明的具体犯罪行为提出指控。如果证据不足，则应申请释放他们。

（签名）小 R. T. 布莱恩（R. T. Bryan, Jr.）
市政法务官

Sir,
    With reference to the last paragraph on the attached
opinion by Mr. Bryan I beg to report that I am entirely in
agreement with his views.
    In making arrests in raids for gangs of robbers, kid-
nappers or others there are undoubtedly a number of innocent
persons arrested during the initial raids.
    It is impossible to avoid this happening because every
one in contact with the gang must be arrested to prevent
information to the other members not arrested from leaking
out.
    The case has to go to Court within a few hours of the
original arrests and if a specific charge is preferred it is
impossible to prepare sufficient evidence in the short time
at the disposal of the detectives to satisfy the Municipal
Advocate or the Court.
    Again if a specific charge is preferred and the Police
have to withdraw against certain members of the gang charged,
it must leave a certain indecision in the mind of the Judge
as to whether the other persons charged are guilty or not.
    In the case of a Writ of Detention however the circum-
stances are entirely different and all in the favour of the
prosecution. All the persons arrested are held in custody
for some time (generally a week), during which time the detec-
tives can complete their arrests and ascertain who are actually
the guilty persons.
    Charges can be prepared and persons found to have no
connection with the cases can be released and not locked up
on remand for an indefinite period as is often the case when a

报告

档案号 ____
总部刑事处巡捕房，
日期 1932年4月22日

事由（全称） 见附件

由 ____ 和 ____ 编制，由 Quayle 警司转呈

先生：

关于附件中 Bryan 先生意见的最后一段，谨此报告，我完全同意他的观点。

在对抢劫团伙、绑架者或其他犯罪团伙进行突击搜查并实施逮捕时，毫无疑问，在最初的突击行动中会有数名无辜者被捕。

这种情况无法避免，因为必须逮捕与团伙有接触的所有人员，以防止信息泄露给其他尚未被捕的成员。

案件必须在最初逮捕后的几小时内送交法庭，如果提出具体指控，侦探们在有限的时间内不可能准备好足够的证据来满足工部局公诉人或法庭的要求。

此外，如果提出了具体指控，而警方不得不撤销对某些被控团伙成员的指控，这必然会使法官对其他被控人员是否有罪产生某种不确定感。

然而，在签发拘留令的情况下，情况则完全不同，且所有因素均有利于控方。所有被捕人员将被羁押一段时间（通常为一周），在此期间，侦探们可以完成逮捕工作，并查明谁实际上是罪犯。

可以准备指控，并将发现与案件无关的人员释放，而不是像经常发生的那样，因提出具体指控而将他们无限期地还押候审。

（左侧手写批注：如果没有证据，就不应该这样。Rcy.）
（左侧手写批注：我同意）
（左侧手写批注：也是。这并非危险，而是相当不公平。Rcy!）

F. 21

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
File No. ________________

April 20, 1932.

Sir,

Re Associates of Criminals.

I think it would be best to have a Crime
Branch Memo issued for information of all detectives.
Then Police action would be uniform. I am in favour
of the use of a Writ of Detention where gangs of
suspects are arrested.

（批：a bad practice which should be Correctly Suppressed / Local）

Detectives usually prefer charging them as a
Criminal Gang, as this method boosts their arrests,
even if half are subsequently released, they always
claim the original number of arrests. These figures
do not present to the Public a true state of crime
when half are later released.

The charge of being a member of a Criminal
Gang should not be preferred unless the Police are
in a position to prove same.

（批：Panic?）

〔签名〕
D.D.O. "B" Division.

D.C. (Crime)
pages.zh:
F. 21

（刑事侦缉处）办公室笔记
档案号 ___

1932年4月20日。

先生：

关于罪犯的同伙。

我认为最好发布一份刑事处备忘录，供所有侦探知悉。
这样警方的行动就能统一。我赞成在逮捕成群的嫌疑人时使用拘留令。

（批：这是一种不良做法，应予以正确制止 / Local）

侦探们通常倾向于以“犯罪团伙”罪名起诉他们，因为这种方法能增加他们的逮捕人数，即使随后有一半人被释放，他们总是声称最初的逮捕数量。当后来有一半人被释放时，这些数字并不能向公众展示真实的犯罪状况。

除非警方有能力证明，否则不应提出身为犯罪团伙成员的指控。

（批：恐慌？）

〔签名〕
“B”区副助理总监。

刑事处副总监

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

D.D.O. "D" Office, ____ Station,
REPORT
Date April 21st, 19 32

Subject (in full) Criminal Gang.

Made by ________ and ________ Forwarded by Supt: Conduit.

（批：But both are not necessary for the same end. of a specific charge?）
（批：I do not agree Rca）

Sir :
According to the circumstances in each case, the preferring of a charge of "Being a member of a Criminal Gang" against a number of persons, or whether a "Writ of Detention" should be applied for should be left to the Investigating Officer. Both the gang charge, or the granting of a writ of detention greatly assist us in our work.

When an Investigation Officer makes a number of arrests, he must be in possession of certain evidence, and other arrests are expected, he is in a position to bring his prisoners before the first available Court on a charge of being members of a criminal gang, under Article 161, and any subsequent arrests are charged under the same article, in fact arrests are made during the following weeks, the criminal gang charge gives him a base for all further charges, and simplifies the details of the whole case when before the Court.

When arrests have been made on very slender circumstances and the Investigating Officer wants time to obtain additional evidence before a definite charge can be made, by the Judge granting a writ of detention, he is greatly assisting us in our work. If no additional evidence can be secured the suspects are released by the Court, in fact, they were not charged, and no dismissal of the charge takes place.

（批：Exactly Rca!）

I am strongly in favour of preferring a "Gang Charge" against a number of persons whom the Investigating Officer can prove have acted together in committing crimes.

In the event of one or two accused in a gang being dismissed for lack of evidence, that cannot be avoided, for in most cases, the circumstances of the arrest gives the Investigating Officer

（批：I am not except you can prove it in accordance with the Law. Why not put the actual charge? A very different thing when the others are convicted of a specific crime. Rca!）

“D”区副助理总监办公室，____ 巡捕房，
报告
日期 1932年4月21日

事由（全称） 犯罪团伙。

由 ________ 和 ________ 编制，由 Conduit 警司转呈。

（批：但两者对于达到同一目的并非都是必要的。具体指控？）
（批：我不同意 Rca）

先生：
根据每个案件的具体情况，是对多人提出“身为犯罪团伙成员”的指控，还是申请“拘留令”，应由调查警官决定。无论是团伙指控，还是签发拘留令，都极大地协助了我们的工作。

当调查警官实施多次逮捕时，他必须掌握一定的证据，并且预计会有进一步的逮捕，他可以根据第161条，以犯罪团伙成员的罪名将囚犯提送至第一个可开庭的法庭，任何随后的逮捕也根据同一条款提出指控，事实上，在接下来的几周内进行的逮捕，犯罪团伙指控为他所有的进一步指控提供了基础，并简化了在法庭上整个案件的细节。

当逮捕是基于非常薄弱的情况，而调查警官希望在提出明确指控之前有时间获取额外证据时，法官签发拘留令极大地协助了我们的工作。如果无法获得额外证据，嫌疑人将由法庭释放，事实上，他们并未被正式起诉，因此也不存在撤销指控的情况。

（批：正是如此 Rca!）

我强烈赞成对调查警官能够证明共同实施犯罪的多人提出“团伙指控”。

如果团伙中的一两名被告因证据不足而被驳回起诉，这是无法避免的，因为在大多数情况下，逮捕的情况使调查警官

（批：除非你能依法证明，否则我不接受。为什么不提出实际指控？当其他人因具体罪行被定罪时，情况就大不相同了。Rca!）
